fair_value_reason: Round-2 agent FVs are $1.23 / $1.00 / $1.10 / $0.72 / $0.83 (mean $0.98), all now on the corrected base: 147.08M basic / 156.75M fully diluted shares rising to ~165-172M with ATM funding, ~US$8.6M estimated cash at Sep 30 plus a ~US$5M ICTK stake (C$6.8M cost, C$7.5M June mark), and six-figure first-year Kaia revenue. Discounted 2028-29 revenue of US$8-15M at 12-18x, plus probability-weighted 2030 outcomes and ~US$14M of assets, gives $0.70-1.25. I take $1.00, down from my round-1 $1.20, because the base-rate arguments for slow scaling (agents 4 and 5) are better supported than the bull weight in agent 1. FV has little pull on a 12-month price for a theme stock, so it does not drive the ladder.
supervisor_summary: BTQ is a pre-revenue PQC company at $3.17 (~US$466M) with an estimated ~C$12M of cash, C$9.25M of commitments due within a year and a going-concern note. Its first recurring deal (Kaia/LINE NEXT) brings six-figure first-year revenue, and its flagship QCIM chip has an FPGA beta still unconfirmed seven weeks after 'imminent'. Round-2 fair values fell to $0.72-1.23 and I now reconcile at $1.00, so the stock trades at about 3x fundamental value on narrative. The agents converged on a ~$2.43 median with a fat right tail, but that convergence is mostly anchoring on my round-1 file. I keep their ladder except for a small far-right-tail trim. There is no checked edge versus the S&P 500; at most this is a ~1% lottery-ticket position, and nothing should be bought before the mid-November Q3 filing.
key_drivers: Funding: ~C$12M estimated cash at Sep 30 (to be reported mid-November), C$9.25M of contractual commitments due within a year, ~C$7M a quarter of burn and a going-concern note. ATM dilution of ~8-14% a year is near certain.
Valuation gap: reconciled fundamental FV of ~$1.00 versus $3.17 spot (~US$466M on 147.08M shares). The premium is a quantum/PQC narrative premium.

Binary QCIM milestones inside the horizon: standalone samples Q1 2027 and production tape-out Q2 2027. The FPGA beta is already ~7 weeks past 'imminent'. BTQ still needs a separate commercialization agreement with ICTK.
Commercial traction is real but tiny: the Kaia/LINE NEXT fee share brings six-figure USD in year one. The only earlier revenue came from a related party.
Theme beta: quantum and crypto-quantum sentiment cycles (Oct 2025 to $16, May-June 2026 +90%) set the fat right tail and dominate 12-month variance.
